paper_title: Overview of the Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment (CASPEr)
notes: Overview/proposal paper presenting sensitivity PROJECTIONS for CASPEr Electric (axion-gluon/nuclear EDM coupling g_d, Fig.3) and CASPEr Wind (ALP-nucleon coupling g_aNN in GeV^-1, Fig.4). Both are projections, not measured limits. No numerical data points are provided in tables or text — only schematic figures. The Wind result is on g_aNN vs ALP mass (AxionNeutron, using 129Xe which is neutron-rich), while the Electric result is on g_d (AxionEDM). Multiple coupling types present, no extractable numerical data, so confidence is low. Local DM density ~0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed.
